theme: Behavioural finance: volatility ≠ loss, avoiding panic selling, staying invested
headline: Market swings are normal, not permanent losses
body: Volatility is part of investing. Market ups and downs don't mean you've lost money unless you sell during downturns.
caption: Panic selling during market dips often locks in losses unnecessarily. Understanding that short-term fluctuations are different from actual losses helps investors stay composed. History shows patient investors who don't react emotionally tend to see better outcomes. #BehaviouralFinance #MarketVolatility #InvestorMindset #StayInvested #EmotionalIntelligence
